annotation.interpretation_a: The Location URI is fully specified without a fragment, meaning it does not contain a '#' character and any following characters.
annotation.interpretation_b: The Location URI has a fragment component that is empty (i.e., '#'), which is a valid fragment but contains no actual fragment identifier.
annotation.justification: The phrase 'does not have a fragment component' can be interpreted in two ways: either the URI literally lacks a '#' character, or it has a '#' character but no identifier following it. The specification needs to clarify whether an empty fragment is considered 'having' a fragment component.
annotation.missing_information: The specification does not explicitly define whether an empty fragment (just '#') is considered 'having a fragment component' or not. This distinction affects how the redirection is handled.
